text: {"assertions":["On 2026-03-24, a data loss bug in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt was identified and fixed.","The data loss only occurred for deeply nested inputs exceeding six levels.","The bug manifested as a local row missing after the next app launch.","The root cause was a cache entry that was never invalidated on write.","The fix involved invalidating the cache entry inside the write transaction in PR #5108 on branch fix/data-loss-1.","The bug could be reproduced by force-stopping the app with unsynced edits.","After the fix, the nightly rollup matched source counts for 23 consecutive days, confirming the fix was successful."]}
